code: export function register(){if("serviceWorker"in navigator){window.addEventListener("load",()=>{const swUrl=`${process.env.PUBLIC_URL}/service-worker.js`;navigator.serviceWorker.register(swUrl).then(()=>{console.log("Service Worker registered");}).catch(error=>{console.log("Service Worker registration failed:",error);});});}}export function unregister(){if("serviceWorker"in navigator){navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(registration=>{registration.unregister();}).catch(()=>{});}}
